10 Of The Sexiest Date Night Perfumes For Men - Style & Grooming

10 Of The Sexiest Date Night Perfumes For Men
Colognes That Will Make Your Date Night Memorable
Tharayil Aishwarya Gopinath
The first rule of date night is wearing a signature scent. Women judge men by the cologne they wear, in case you didn’t know. Shopping for the right date night perfume can confusing. So before you break your head, we broke down 10 of the sexiest date night perfumes just so that you get your date night going real strong.
1. YVES SAINT LAURENT LA NUIT DE L’HOMME EAU DE TOILETTE SPRAY
The smooth yet powerful cologne has a way of attracting people to its scent. If you’re already itching for a hint of attention from your girl, try this cologne out. It’s a strong blend of spicy cardamom, bergamot, lavender, cedar – all ingredients of masculine fragrance. Anne flipo, Pierre wargnye and Dominique ropion are the noses behind the 2009 Yves Saint Laurent la unit de lhomme.
2. Versace Eros Eau De Toilette
The Eros fragrance by Versace has been inspired by the God of love. If you prefer something sensual on your skin that shows your passionate side, this exotic fragrance is just the right one. The freshness from the cologne comes from the perfect combination of mint leaves, Italian lemon zest, and green apple. This scent is swoon-worthy, my friend.
3. Armaf Club De Nuit Intense Men's EDT Perfume
The black beauty has a woody spicy scent that’s reminiscent of everything masculine. Its juicy blend of lemon, apple, and blackcurrant with a slight tinge of floral heart rose and spiced up jasmine will have your girl longing for your undying attention.
4. Dior Christian Sauvage EDT Spray
Inspired by wide, open spaces, Sauvage by Christian Dior is definitely a celebrity scent. It’s powerful and made to last. The unexpected combination of Reggio di Calabria Bergamo and Ambroxan leaves behind an opulent woody scent which makes for the perfect cologne right before a big occasion – in your case, a date.
5. Mercedes-Benz VIP Club Eau De Toilette by Honorine Blanc
The understated elegance of this cologne is what we love about it. It’s bold. It’s intense. And it’s definitely a scent your girl will fall for. Keynotes like bergamot, orris heart are rounded with a touch of leather and amber. It’s not difficult to see why this perfume would not make a great impression.
6. Nautica Voyage Eau de Toilette For Men
If you associate yourself with the wildness of nature, the Nautica Voyage is perfect for you. It’s crisp and refreshing like the breeze of the sea. It’s the perfect indulgent for a sensual date night because it carries the scents of coastal herbs and woods, enough to make your date fall in love with you in no time. Trust the fragrance, guys.
7. Unforgivable By Sean John For Men. Eau De Toilette Spray
Another big name in the date-night fragrance game is the Unforgivable. It’s suitable for any kind of date, especially the ones where a woman is involved. It’s no secret that this cologne is well-constructed and extremely elegant that is bound to last on your skin. When it comes to men’s cologne, you should always go with something that fresh just like this one.
8. Calvin Klein CK Be EDT
It’s simply one of the best perfumes for men available in the market right now. It has a distinctive fragrance, thanks to the spicy juniper notes and the combination of mint and tangerine. This laid-back scent is not at all overpowering, but yes, it’s a scent that will separate you from the rest.
9. Davidoff Champion Spray EDT
Need a fresh, new fragrance to wear on date night? This one, right here, has you covered. It’s a seductive fragrance that can unleash ‘the man’ in you. You’ll also love the bottle.
10. Paco Rabanne Pour Homme For Men
The Paco Rabanne Pour Homme For Men an intoxicating scent that captures the masculine side of the wearer. Crafted by Jean Martel, the scent has top notes of rosemary, clary sage, and Brazilian rosewood, middle notes of tonka bean, lavender, and geranium, base notes of honey, amber, musk, and oakmoss – all sure to mask the butterflies in your stomach.
